THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the ↓S day of March, 2007 by and between 29 WEST 46"h sTREET ASSOCIATES, a New York general partnership with an address c/o B.H.T. Corp. 21 West 46"h Street, New Delaware limited liability company ("Developer"), having an address c/o Extell Development Company,805Third Ave.,Seventh Floor,NewYork,NY 10022. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,LowerParcelOwner istheownerinfeeofcertainland,withthe buildings and improvements thereon, which land and improvements lie below a horizontal plane (the “Lower Limiting Plane") drawn at an elevation of one hundred fifty-eight (158) feet above the datum used by the Topographic Bureau of the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, (which is 2.75 feet above the United States Coast and Geodetic Survey mean sea level datum, Sandy Hook, New Jersey) ("Manhattan Datum"), located in the Borough of Manhattan, County, City and State of New York, known as Tax Lot 123 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York, (the “Tax Map"), known and numbered as 29 West 46th Street, New York, New York (said land being called the “Lower Parcel Land" as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Lower Parcel Building,” and the Lower Parcel Land and the Lower Parcel Building being herein collectively called the“Lower Premises"); WHEREAS,Developer acquired from the Lower Parcel Owner by deed (the “Airspace Deed") dated of even date herewith the volume of air which lies above the Lower LimitingPlane,locatedwithin the boundaries of theLowerParcel Land and designated as part of Tax Lot 123 (Tentative Tax Lot 9123) in Block 1262 on the Tax Map (as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, being herein called the“Airspace Premises"), so that on the date hereof Lower Parcel Owner is the owner in fee of the Lower Premises and Developer is the owner in fee of the AirspacePremises; WHEREAS,by execution of a Declaration of ZoningLot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith (the“Declaration"), Lower Parcel Owner and Developer have utilized the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the LowerParcel Land with the Airspace Premises so as to create a new,combined zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement (the “Combined Zoning Lot"), for the purpose of making available the Subject Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building; WHEREAS, the parties have caused all parties in interest (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Combined Zoning Lot, as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Company ("Certification"), annexed hereto as Exhibit E, to waive their right to execute any Declarations relating to any future expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot and to subordinate their respective interest to this Agreement, as amended, by execution of a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions and Subordination to Zoning Lot Development Agreement; together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement being called the “Developer Building") (the Developer Land and the Developer Building collectively, the "Developer Premises"), and/or (ii) other volumes of air, Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) or parcels of land ("Additional Parcels") that are contiguous with the Combined Zoning Lot or with each other for at least ten (10) linear feet, located in the County of New York,City and State of New York,in Block 1262 on the Tax Map, and (B) to merge the Combined Zoning Lot with the Developer Premises and/or the Additional Parcels to create an enlarged Combined Zoning Lot; WHEREAS,Developer desires to construct a new building (the“New Developer Building") on a development site located on a zoning lot (as hereinafter defined) which will include Developer's Premises (the “Development Site") with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Development Site under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Development Site was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant, as of the date hereof, to theLowerParcel Landwhich are in excess of theUtilized Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) (the“Excess Floor Area Development Rights") and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS,thepartiesheretowish tosetforthcertain agreementswithrespect totheirrights andobligationsin andtotheCombined ZoningLot,as thesamemaybefurther enlarged or subdivided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement and other matters, and wish to provide to the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or other action from the other; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. CertainDefinitions.As used herein: A. "Building” shall mean, with respect to Lower Parcel Owner, the Lower Parcel Building, and with respect to Developer, the Developer Building. B. “Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or other day on whichcommercialbanksareauthorizedtobeclosedintheStateofNewYork. C. "Bonus Floor Area Development Rights"shall mean any bonus floor area and other development rights attributed to the Combined Zoning Lotwhich may be available for inclusion in a building constructed thereon through the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on or off the Combined Zoning Lot, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the ZoningResolution. 2 KL3 2560293.9
